exposure: Women who did not feel scared
Complicated birth requiring maternity high-dependency care
complicated birth requiring maternity high-dependency care
cohort: 112 women who received care in a maternity high dependency unit in the first 24 hours after birth
finding: Women who did not feel scared during their high-dependency care were more likely to report having a clinician explain their situation, feeling in control, and less likely to feel helpless.
mod_finding: This study explored experiences of women who received care in a high dependency unit after complicated births, without specifically analyzing mode of delivery as a factor.
